from tools import search_flights, search_hotels, search_restaurants, filter_flights, filter_hotels, filter_restaurants, sort_results, get_results_from_cache, save_to_cache

# Retrieve previous search results from cache
departure_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="departure_flights")
return_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="return_flights")
hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")
filtered_hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="filtered_hotels")
restaurants = get_results_from_cache(key="restaurants")

# Filter flights based on user preferences (economy class, max 1 layover, max layover 1 duration 60 minutes)
filtered_departure_flights = filter_flights(prior_results=departure_flights, flight_class=["economy"], num_layovers=[0, 1], layover_1_duration_minutes=60)
filtered_return_flights = filter_flights(prior_results=return_flights, flight_class=["economy"], num_layovers=[0, 1], layover_1_duration_minutes=60)

# Filter hotels based on user preferences (budget $55, airport shuttle, beach access)
filtered_hotels_result = filter_hotels(prior_results=hotels, budget=55, airport_shuttle_present=True, has_beach_access=True)

# Filter restaurants based on user preferences (Korean cuisine, tomato allergy options)
filtered_restaurants_result = filter_restaurants(prior_results=restaurants, cuisine=["Korean"], has_tomato_allergy_options=True)

# Sort results based on user preferences
sorted_departure_flights = sort_results(results=filtered_departure_flights, column="economy_class_price", ascending=True)
sorted_return_flights = sort_results(results=filtered_return_flights, column="economy_class_price", ascending=True)
sorted_hotels = sort_results(results=filtered_hotels_result, column="price_per_night", ascending=True)
sorted_restaurants = sort_results(results=filtered_restaurants_result, column="price_per_person", ascending=True)

# Save results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_departure_flights", value=sorted_departure_flights)
save_to_cache(key="filtered_return_flights", value=sorted_return_flights)
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=sorted_hotels)
save_to_cache(key="filtered_restaurants", value=sorted_restaurants)
